description.narrative: This project promotes and strengthens the rule of law at national and international levels by: (a) promoting the implementation n of the Latimer House Principles; (b) strengthening legislative drafting and law reform capacity; (c) establishing of a Commonwealth Pro Bono Centre to enable Qualifying Commonwealth Countries to access free legal services from international law firms in support of their efforts to realise their SDG targets ; and (d) promoting law reform to end discrimination against women and girls and other vulnerable persons.??
